edges.note: BARRIER DENOMINATOR: RC (job 1152, -244.935406907) = this step's own starting minimum. Note that the reactant minimum DIRECTLY connected to TS1 is the HNCO.H2O water-rotamer minimum (-244.926200303, +5.78 kcal/mol above RC, job 1294); the rotamer -> RC link is a 0.27 kcal/mol e0 conformational step (job 1298) and is NOT added to this barrier, so RC and the rotamer are the same reactant state at 298 K. Using the rotamer as denominator would give +31.00 kcal/mol, which is not the reported value. E1, water O4 attacks C2 while H6 migrates from O4 to N1 (4-centre, concerted). Barrier = E(TS1) - E(this step's own starting minimum RC) = -244.876786249 - (-244.935406907) = +0.058620658 Ha = +36.79 kcal/mol (pure electronic, same program/method). TS has exactly one imaginary mode on the declared pairs; IRC both directions connects RC and carbamic acid; both endpoints Opt+Freq with 0 imaginary modes (RC -244.935406911 job 1285, carbamic acid -244.966495971 job 1288). The durable run verdict is candidate_only because the 10-point IRC cap cannot bring the outer frame within the interval-proof alignment gate of the RC minimum (dmat RMSD 1.347 A vs ~0.335 A for the accepted E3 endpoints) - a platform limitation, not a missing saddle. Index convention = 1-based map numbers of the task reactant SMILES [NH:1]=[C:2]=[O:3].[OH2:4] (the two water H are equivalent; H6 denotes the migrating one).
